text: Alex Chen: FYI linkcheck in staging flagged a handful of broken fragment links after the API sync PR. failing fragments look like `#/api/auth.login‌` -> generated `#/api/auth.login‌`. Priya Nair: interesting, that ‌ is a ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER, right? could be copy-paste from a spec or export. where do we see it? Noor Ahmed: looks like `docs/api/auth.md` had a manual `` added when we converted the old swagger snippets. i didn't notice the invisible char in the id. Jamie Ortiz: we should treat non-printable chars as lint failures. i can add a docs-lint rule to fail on anything matching `\p{C}` inside heading ids and inline id attributes. Alex Chen: prefer not to change build heuristics unless necessary. quick source patch + linter sounds good. Noor, can you open a PR to remove the stray id and run linkcheck locally? Noor Ahmed: opening PR now -> #4201. removing inline anchor and replacing with standard markdown heading. will run `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally. docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck reported 3 broken fragments in commit 9f8a7c. files: docs/api/auth.md (line 28), docs/guides/migration.md (line 173) Priya Nair: migration.md might have been touched by the same automated converter. Noor, grep for invisible chars across docs with: `grep -nP "[\x{200B}-\x{200D}\x{FEFF}]" -r docs/` — that should catch ZWSP, ZWJ, ZWNJ and BOM. Noor Ahmed: ran the grep, found 6 hits across api/ and guides/. patching them in the PR. Jamie Ortiz: opened lint PR #4209 that adds a rule and test fixtures: one entry showing a zero-width space in a manually added id, another showing a soft hyphen sneaking into a heading. Linter will run as part of docs CI. Noor Ahmed: local linkcheck now clean after fixes. pushed -> CI job kicked. docs-bot: CI: docs/build-staging for PR #4201 linkcheck step passed, build succeeded. Alex Chen: thanks. follow-ups: Jamie to land linter, Priya to run a quick audit for manual ids and redirects, Noor to merge after green. Priya Nair: i'll also run a script to list `id="` usages and cross-check them against generated TOC anchors; if there's a mismatch we'll add an entry to `redirects.yml`. Jamie Ortiz: will add a short note to the docs contributing guide about avoiding manual ids and using explicit slug overrides only when necessary. Noor Ahmed: merging now, will watch post-deploy link logs. Alex Chen: appreciated. if any customer reports come in about 404 anchor jumps please forward here and we'll triage.
